### 5. Define feature-wide architecture when needed

For a multi-slice feature, create `system-design.md`, defining only shared architecture and contracts and mapping each requirement ID to an owning slice. When it is ready, run [document-set coherence review](skill://orchestrate-factory/references/document-review--when-coherence-review-runs.md) before its developer gate.
